note: Events for the stuck-hold rules 100322 and 100323 (ISC-173). Each event is the logged text of a full_command run: the alias line, a newline, the probe's output. want is the id wazuh-logtest reports as the last rule to match (100322 pass, 100323 alert, - means the last rule is neither of them: an age rule, 100320 or 100321, or the stock 530). Feed each event with log_format full_command and location 'soc-recon tier2 hold' (the age drill in Plans/t2-tests/suite.sh does the same for its alias). tools/tier2-hold.test.ts checks every want against the shipped rule text offline; only the scratch manager proves it against the real engine.
